services.name: Boat rental
services.desc: When most people think about spending a day on the water, they immediately picture a busy Saturday afternoon. But savvy boaters know the real secret: weekdays are one of the best times to get out on Lake Murray. Whether you’re looking to unwind after work, catch more fish, or simply enjoy the lake without the weekend crowds, a weekday boat rental offers plenty of advantages. Here are seven reasons why you should plan your next boating adventure Monday through Friday. Let’s face it-work weeks can be hectic. blurb: Better Boating rents newer, larger powerboats including pontoons and tritoons, as well as kayaks, paddleboards, and pedal boats. Guests can fish, cruise, swim, ski, tube, or relax on the water. Rentals include safety equipment and basic instruction, with a focus on safety and guest confidence.
